title: Shogakukan Announces Findings from 3rd-Party Investigation, Measures Company Will Take to Prevent Recurrence After Shōichi Yamamoto Scandal
content:
Shogakukan revealed on August 3 a summary of findings following the third-party investigation into the publisher's Manga ONE editorial department and involvement with manga creator Shōichi Yamamoto . On August 4, the company then released a list of measures that it plans to enact in response to the findings.

Summary of Findings

Sponichi Annex reported that the external committee received reports of 44 incidents, including similar suspected incidents of sexual misconduct and other misconduct, during the investigation through its dedicated hotlines. The incidents included misconduct from senior executives, employees abusing the power of their positions, as well as misconduct from editors toward creatives. The committee found that in some of these cases, the company took the appropriate course of action, but in other cases the response was insufficient.

According to news website Kai-You, the report also stated editorial decisions were prioritized even in cases where human rights violations were suspected, and coordination between editorial, legal, administrative, and managerial departments did not function sufficiently.

The committee specifically criticized that regarding the victim in Yamamoto's case, the company "encouraged and supported" the violation of her human rights.

The committee concluded that Shogakukan did not always have sufficient systems in place to: acknowledge the perspective of the victims of human rights violations, "prevent itself from encouraging and supporting human rights violations," recognize the inherent power imbalance in relationships between editors and authors and other clients, and manage and assess significant risks (including human rights violation risks).

The company's executive staff — including the CEO, managing directors, board members, and auditors — will cut their monthly salaries for a period of three months. The president will reduce his salary by 50% during this period, and the other members will reduce their salaries by 20-30%.

Proposed Measures

Shogakukan stated it has compiled a list of measures it will enact in order to "apply the proposals from the third-party committee as concrete policy." These measures relate to the company's practices in general, as well as preventative measures in response to Yamamoto's sex crime case .

The preventative changes the company will enforce include five measures:

• Formation of the Shogakukan Human Rights Policy and Human Rights Commission

The company drafted the Shogakukan Human Rights Policy on March 19 (available in English here ), which expresses its intent to respect and protect fundamental human rights in every area of the company's activities. Shogakukan will also establish a Human Rights Committee — led by senior managing director Kumiko Hanazuka (name romanization not confirmed) as chairperson and with involvement from external experts — to prevent, mitigate, and correct human rights violations within the company.

• Expansion of human rights training and corporate culture reform

Shogakukan will regularly hold training to teach and reinforce respect for human rights, prevention of sexual violence and harassment, victim support, and whistleblowing procedures. Managers will additionally undertake a separate program regarding the correct procedure for supervision, guidance in their roles, and contact with external parties. The company will also offer human rights seminars to writers, authors, and freelancers.

• Revised system and process for working with external creators

The company will review its human rights policy with external creators and include clauses in its contracts with respect to human rights. In the event of violations or concerns raised in areas related to human rights by external creators, the company will create a clear authority structure for reporting and decision-making that will involve the editorial department, legal department, and administrative departments, who will determine whether to continue the business relationship with that creator or business partner.

• Strengthen supervisory bodies and systems

The Board of Directors will regularly report on human rights violations and implement oversight at the management level. When violations are found, the company will investigate whether similar incidents have occurred in other divisions. Decisions regarding human rights violations will be reviewed by the Risk Management Office, Human Rights Committee, and Legal Department before management verifies the results. Special response committees will also be established depending on the severity of the violation.

• Establish and reform internal whistleblowing, reporting, investigating systems

The company will establish a "grievance system" compliant with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights. The system will incorporate the opinions of external human rights experts, especially in cases of serious violations, and allow victims (regardless of whether they have a direct contractual relationship to Shogakukan ) to file complaints. The existing reporting system will be revamped and will account for anonymous reporting and protection measures after reporting. Sexual assault cases will have a specialized response system including psychological counseling for victims.

Shogakukan also promises to continually review and renew its preventative measures for effectiveness.

Shogakukan stated it will post the full list of proposed measures in English in the future, and ANN will update this article to link to that English document once it is available. The document is not available in English as of press time.

On February 20, the Sapporo District Court handed down a ruling in a civil case ordering a man to pay 11 million yen (about US$71,000) in damages to a woman in her 20s, who claimed that Yamamoto repeatedly sexually abused and raped her while she was in a distance-learning high school in Sapporo and while he was a teacher at her school. The woman originally filed the civil suit in July 2022.

According to the Okayama-based economic media outlet "Ashita no Keizai Shimbun" (Tomorrow's Economic Newspaper) on February 25, the defendant, named Shōichi Yamamoto , was the same as the manga creator of the manga series Daten Sakusen .

Other news outlets reported that in February 2020, in a separate criminal case, a summary court convicted Yamamoto of violating the Child Prostitution and Pornography Prohibition Act and he was ordered to pay a penalty of 300,000 yen (about US$1,900).

The victim in the case announced in March that she and her lawyers are appealing the court's initial ruling in the civil case, as it did not acknowledge the school's wrongdoing in the case. The victim had initially filed the civil suit against Yamamoto, the teaching staff, and the educational corporation that operated Hokkaidō Geijutsu Kōkō Sapporo Satellite Campus, the distance-learning high school she attended at the time.

Yamamoto began serializing Daten Sakusen on Manga ONE in February 2015. The manga went on hiatus in February 2020, and was removed from Manga ONE in October 2022.

However, in 2022, Manga ONE started serialization on writer " Hajime Ichiro " and artist Eri Tsuruyoshi 's Jōjin Kamen manga, even though " Hajime Ichiro " and Shōichi Yamamoto were the same person. Manga ONE announced on February 27 that it has halted digital distribution of the Jōjin Kamen manga, and also halted shipments of the physical compiled volumes of the manga. Shogakukan stated it should not have hired " Hajime Ichiro " as the original writer of the manga.

Shogakukan also noted that during the civil case that ended on February 20, a manga editor participated in the settlement negotiations, advising that the parties hire a lawyer to prepare notarized documents for the settlement. Other news outlets reported the manga editor advised the notarized documents include the condition the female victim could not disclose the matter, and also proposed that Yamamoto pay 1.5 million yen (about US$9,700) as settlement.

Manga ONE and Shogakukan both apologized to readers and other creators who contribute to Manga ONE , stating at the time it would set up a third-party investigative committee that would include lawyers to clarify the facts of the situation, particularly to understand how the manga serialization began and the involvement of an editor in the settlement negotiations.

After Manga ONE and Shogakukan published their statements, many manga creators took to social media to criticize the statements and Shogakukan in general, and many stated they would pull their manga from the Manga ONE platform.

The Kyodo news agency reported on March 1 that Shogakukan had postponed the ceremony for the winners of the 71st Shogakukan Manga Awards, which was scheduled to be held on March 3.

The previous scandal prompted Shogakukan to undergo an internal investigation.

Shogakukan announced on March 2 that the Manga ONE editorial department needed to investigate the process and verification system for hiring the original creator of the Seisō no Shinri-shi manga, which had been serialized on the Manga ONE service. Miki Yatsunami , the manga's original creator, is the pen name of act-age manga writer Tatsuya Matsuki , who was arrested and indicted on the charge of committing a coerced indecent act on a female middle school student in 2020.

The Manga ONE editorial department explained in the statement how it came to re-hire Matsuki, and that the Miki Yatsunami pen name was initially chosen out of consideration for the victims so they would not be re-victimized.

While Shogakukan insisted its decision to have Matsuki use a pen name for the new work was always intended to be at the best interest of the victims, the company admitted the Manga ONE editorial staff should have given more consideration as to whether this decision was truly in consideration of the victims.

Shogakukan temporarily suspended updates for Seisō no Shinri-shi .
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Begins Streaming Third Opening Song "Song of Light" by Yuiko Ohara
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a new opening song following the premiere of Episode 8 on August 16. The episode began the Chaos Breaker arc , which recently revealed a trailer. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup . The new opening song is titled “Hikari no Uta” (“Song of Light)” and is performed by Yuiko Ohara. The song is now available on the major music streaming platforms .

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

You can also check out the teaser trailer for the new arc below.

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

You can also see the key visual for the third season.

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.
author: Anime Corner

title: Witch Hat Atelier Wins Astra Award for Best Anime
content:
Tthe film critics in the Hollywood Creative Alliance (formerly the Hollywood Critics Association) gave the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga the award for Best Anime Series at the 2026 Astra TV Awards on Saturday.

The other nominees included :

• Dandelion

• MAO

• Rooster Fighter

• Sakamoto Days

• STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure

Anjali Kunapaneni and Patrick Seitz were both nominated for Best Lead Voice Over Performance in a Series for their English dub work, with Kunapaneni nominated for her role as Coco in Witch Hat Atelier , and Seitz nominated for his role as Keiji in Rooster Fighter .

Joshua Waters was also nominated for Best Supporting Voice Over Performance in a Series for his role as Qifrey in Witch Hat Atelier .

The awards ceremony took place in Los Angeles on August 15.

Witch Hat Atelier premiered on April 6 on Tokyo MX and on other channels. The anime is receiving a second season .

The HCA hosts four sets of awards: the Astra Creative Arts Awards, the Astra Film Awards, the Astra Podcast Awards, and the Astra TV Awards. The organization is composed of critics, journalists, actors, producers, podcasters, publicists, writers, and "other creatives across the entertainment landscape."

The first Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle anime film won the "Animation is Cinema" honorary award at the 9th Annual Astra Film Awards in January.

The Dragon Ball Daima anime won Best Anime Series, and Aleks Le won Best Lead Voice-Over Performance for his role as Sung Jinwoo in the Solo Leveling Season 2 -Arise from the Shadow- anime at the 2025 Astra TV Awards.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime Unleashes Its Hero’s Terrifying New Transformation, But It’s Surprisingly Cute
content:
The Summer of 2026 is also featuring a brand-new shonen anime, which is currently airing on Crunchyroll . The series has rapidly progressed and is already featuring the classic shonen hero transformation that other series take much longer to introduce. Most shonen heroes follow a formulaic structure, with one of the most common dynamics being a hidden power within the demon residing inside their body. After the hero develops a deep bond with the demon within them, a new transformation is usually introduced, representing this bond and a new level of strength.

This is exactly what the ongoing shonen anime Black Torch is already featuring in its seventh episode. Black Torch has been a very fast-paced shonen anime, as its first episode introduced the main hero, Jiro Azuma, to the menacing power of a mononoke, Rago, who is a legend among spirits, and the two already became friendly with each other. As the new episodes were released, more nuances about Rago’s past were unveiled, establishing him as one of the most unique inner demons a shonen hero has had in a while . Now, as Jiro and Rago face an enemy that pushes them to their limits, they unveil a new form that is also surprisingly cute due to its design.

Black Torch Features Its Main Hero Acquiring a Terrifying Yet Adorable New Transformation

Black Torch ‘s latest episode featured the titular unit taking on a new rescue mission, where three different types of mononoke are harboring in the area. Among them is a powerful mononoke that forces Jiro and Rago to fight, resulting in one of the best battles of the series so far. However, the mononoke overpowers Jiro even with Rago backing him up. As the mononoke seemingly wins the fight, Jiro emerges with a new transformation, coating himself in Rago’s black energy , which is perfectly designed to represent Rago’s cat appearance while also making it surprisingly cute. This is further emphasized by Jiro’s cat-like instinct to get rid of the bug bothering him, dismissing the mononoke with his tail and perfectly capturing a cat’s unbothered personality.

However, not everything is sunshine and cuteness with this form, as Rago is able to comprehend how Jiro was able to achieve this new transformation. The episode reveals that the reason mononoke eat humans is because they want to consume the vital energy humans emit, and Rago deduces that by residing inside Jiro, he is chipping away at his vital energy and becoming more powerful the longer he remains inside him. This is indeed a classic trope where inner powers also come with their own nuances.

Considering how the Black Torch manga only spans 19 chapters , the series is indeed going to be a short one, meaning fans will eventually have to see Rago and Jiro part ways. It may come with Rago exhausting his energy completely and dying in the process, or by perfectly merging with Jiro, giving him a new transformation yet again, but with Rago no longer existing as he does now. Regardless of whichever direction Black Torch leans toward, it is already emerging as one of the best shonen anime on Crunchyroll in 2026, and with its latest episode introducing this classic shonen hero transformation, the anime continues to solidify itself as a modern shonen series

title: Sendai Books Licenses Amazoness Kiss, Never Mind Come Together Manga in English
content:
European publisher Sendai Books announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Wednesday it will publish Natsuko Ishitsuyo 's Amazoness Kiss manga and Xian Ozn 's Never Mind Come Together manga in English.

The publisher describes the story of Amazoness Kiss :

A new exclusive club promises training and development of Extrasensory Perception for its special clients. People sure look happy as they leave a session. Well, the ones who are allowed to leave…. Pop stardom, the occult, ambition, and unintended consequences. Welcome to the world of Amazoness Kiss .

Ishitsuyo launched the manga on LEED Publishing 's Torch website in 2017. LEED Publishing shipped the third and final volume in October 2020.

Sendai Books expects to ship the first volume in October, and its website states the book can ship to the United States.

The publisher describes the story of Never Mind Come Together :

Hiroshi is an average guy on the way to attend his daughter's recital. But everything goes south when a misplaced sauce container (?) puts him in the crosshairs of a cannibal mafia boss (??) and a deadly femme fatale (???). Never Mind Come Together is an insane pursuit where everything is happening everywhere and all at once. The minute you finish it, you'll want to start again from the beginning!

Ozn launched the manga on LEED Publishing 's Torch website in 2018. LEED Publishing shipped the single compiled book volume in August 2021.

Sendai Books expects to ship the manga in October, and its website states the book can ship to the United States.

The publisher's X/ Twitter account states it ships its books for free to the European Union, with "affordable shipping everywhere else."
author: ANN

Sendai Books expects to ship the manga in October, and its website states the book can ship to the United States.
The publisher's X/ Twitter account states it ships its books for free to the European Union, with "affordable shipping everywhere else."

title: OSHI NO KO Season 4 (Final Season) Teaser Visual and Trailer Revealed
content:
The previously announced final season, OSHI NO KO Season 4 revealed a teaser visual and trailer. The announcement was made at the Ichigo Production☆Fan Thanksgiving 2026 event held on August 16. The announcement states that the teaser movie video will also be revealed today, while the official website already shared the visual.

You can watch the trailer below.

The TV anime adaptation is based on the manga series written by Aka Akasaka ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) and illustrated by Mengo Yokari ( Scum’s Wish ). The first season premiered in March 2023 and swept our Spring 2023 seasonal rankings , while the second season was also voted as the most anticipated anime of Summer 2024. The third season also bagged multiple awards, including Winter 2026 Anime of the Season . All three seasons were animated by Doga Kobo.

The voice cast consists of:

• Takeo Otsuka as Aquamarine Hoshino

• Yurie Igoma as Ruby Hoshino

• Megumi Han as Kana Arima

• Manaka Iwami as Akane Kurokawa

• Rumi Okubo as Mem-cho

• Lynn as Miyako Saito

• Rie Takahashi as Ai Hoshino

Crunchyroll describes Season 3 as follows: It’s been six months since “POP IN 2” was released. Thanks to MEM-Cho’s hard work, B-Komachi is about to get their major break. Aqua is a multi-talented entertainer, and Akane’s career as a talented actress is going smoothly. Meanwhile, Kana lost the cheerfulness she once had. To track down the truth behind Ai and Goro’s deaths, Ruby keeps rising in the entertainment world… Source: OSHI NO KO Official Website ©Aka Akasaka x Mengo Yokoyari/Shueisha, “OSHI NO KO” Partners

title: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Reveals September 30 Early Streaming Debut, Theme Songs in Trailer
content:
The website for the television anime of Yuu Tanaka and LLO 's Reincarnated as a Sword ( Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita ) light novel series revealed on Sunday the September 30 streaming debut, October 7 television debut, and a new key visual for the anime's second season . HIDIVE began streaming an English-subtitled trailer for the season that previews its opening theme song and reveals its ending theme song.

FZMZ performs the opening theme song "Dream of Butterfly" and Hanabie. performs the ending theme song "Baribari Buddy."

The anime will first debut on the ABEMA streaming service on September 30, before airing on television on the Tokyo MX and ABC TV channels on October 7.

Itsuki Fujioka (romanization of manga creator's name is unconfirmed) will launch a manga spinoff for the franchise titled Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita My Dish on Micro Magazine 's Comic Ride service on September 30.

HIDIVE will stream the anime as it airs in Japan, and will screen the North American premiere of the new season on August 22 at Anime NYC . The panel will feature director Shinji Ishihira and producers Yōsuke Shimada and Genta Ozaki .

The company describes the anime:

Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

The first anime season premiered on Tokyo MX in October 2022 before airing on ABC TV and BS Asahi . Episodes debuted a week early ABEMA service, starting in September 2022. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired and also streamed an English dub .

The series stars Ai Kakuma as Fran, Shinichirō Miki as Master, and Yūma Uchida as Jean du Vix .

Shinji Ishihira ( Fairy Tail , Log Horizon , Edens Zero ) returns to direct the anime at at C2C . Takahiro Nagano ( Duel Masters script writer) is writing and supervising the scripts. Atsuko Saitō ( Hitori Bocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu , Wandering Witch - The Journey of Elaina episode animation director) designs the characters. Yasuharu Takanashi is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Assistant director: Kazunobu Shimizu

• Master design: Shinya Asanuma

• Monster design: Chie Sakurai, Jumpei Mukai, Shōta Yano

• Action director: Rino Isago, Satoshi Sakai, Shunya Nitta

• Color key artist: Masato Takagi, Takeshi Kurihara

• Art director/setting: Masahiro Satō

• Art board: Kōki Nagayoshi

• Prop design: Tomoki Yokoyama, Emi Kōno

• Compositing director of photography: Masaaki Onodera

• 3DCG: Hinokuni Animation

• 2D/Monitor works: Jumpei Mukai

• Editing: Gō Sadamatsu

• Music director: Shōji Hata

Tanaka launched the novels on the Shōsetsuka ni Narou website in October 2015, and Gentosha began publishing the series with illustrations by LLO in July 2016. Tomowo Maruyama launched a manga adaptation of the novels on Gentosha 's Denshi Birz website in December 2016. Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing both the original light novels and Maruyama's manga adaptation in English. The company also launched audiobooks of the novels narrated by Josh Hurley in August 2024.

Hinako Inoue launched the Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita: Another Wish manga spinoff in June 2020 and ended it in its sixth compiled book volume in March 2023.

title: Skip & Loafer Anime's 2nd Season Reveals April 2027 Debut in Teaser Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of Misaki Takamatsu 's Skip and Loafer ( Skip to Loafer ) manga revealed in a teaser video the April 2027 debut of the show's second season .

Kotomi Deai ( Natsume's Book of Friends ) returns from the first season to direct and oversee the series scripts at P.A. Works . Scriptwriter on the first season Yōko Yonaiyama is also overseeing the series scripts alongside Deai. Manami Umeshita ( Stella Women's Academy , High School Division Class C3 ) is returning as the character designer and chief animation director. Reina Igawa is also returning as another chief animation director, and Yūsuke Inoue is returning from animation director on the first season as another chief animation director.

Other staff members on the second season include:

• Sub-Character Design: Mio Fujishima (new)

• Main Animators: Sara Sakoe, Hiroyuki Honda (new), Chieko Satō (new)

• Prop Setting: Satomi Higuchi

• 2D Design, Subtitle Design: Ryo Murakami (new)

• Special Effects: Masahiro Murakami (new), Sumie Murakami (new)

• Background Art: Yūta Fujii

• Art Director: Sō Senoo (new)

• Color Design: Yūko Kobari

• Director of Photography: Akane Ueda (Kazuto Izumita was previously listed in this role)

• 3D Director: Motonari Ichikawa

• Editing: Ayumu Takahashi

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

Junichi Higashi was previously listed as art supervisor but is no longer listed in the staff.

Crunchyroll will stream the second season.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga digitally and in print in English, and it describes the story:

Excellent student Iwakura Mitsumi has always dreamt about leaving her small town, going to a prestigious university, and making positive change in the world. But she's so focused on reaching her goals that she's not prepared for the very different (and overwhelming) city life that awaits her in a Tokyo high school. Luckily, she makes fast friends with Shima Sousuke, a handsome classmate who's as laid-back as she is over-prepared. Can this naive country girl make it big in Tokyo with Sousuke by her side?

The first anime series premiered in April 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

Takamatsu launched the manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Afternoon magazine in August 2018.

The manga ranked #7 in manga for male readers in the 2020 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook. It was nominated in the 13th Manga Taisho awards in 2020, and was also nominated in the Best General Manga category of Kodansha 's 44th annual Manga Awards in 2020.

The manga received a stage musical adaptation that ran in March 2026 in Tokyo and Osaka.

title: Skip and Loafer Season 2 Teaser Trailer Reveals April 2027 Release
content:
Skip and Loafer Season 2 anime revealed the first teaser trailer and visual, along with an April 2027 release date. The anime previously confirmed the main staff members were returning for the sequel , including Kotomi Deai as the director at studio P.A. Works. You can watch the new trailer below.

Studio P.A. Works animated the Skip and Loafer anime adaptation, with direction by Kotomi Deai. Manami Umeshita handled the character design, with Takatsugu Wakabayashi in charge of the music composition. The anime was one of the biggest trends of Spring 2023 , running for 12 episodes from April to June. The main voice cast includes:

• Tomoyo Kurosawa as Mitsumi Iwakura

• Akinori Egoshi as Sosuke Shima

• Maaya Uchida as Yuzuki Marashige

• Yuka Terasaki as Mika Egashira

• Megumi Han as Makoto Kurume

• Mitsuki Saiga as Nao-chan

• Hikaru Tanaka as Mukai Tsukasa

• Ayumu Murase as Kento Yamada

Misaki Takamatsu writes and draws the Skip and Loafer manga, which has been serialized in Kodansha’s Afternoon magazine since 2018. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English, while Crunchyroll is streaming the anime. The story follows the country girl Mitsumi, as she joins a prestigious school in Tokyo and gets struck with the city life. She meets the handsome but aloof Sosuke, and she slowly gets used to the new life while building a relationship with him and her classmates.

title: Toryumon Takeda's Doga Manga Ends in 7th Volume
content:
The sixth volume of Toryumon Takeda 's DOGA manga announced on July 24 the series will end in the seventh volume, which will ship in winter 2026.

An early promotional image for the series described the story:

Yote is as high-ranked as he is unaware of the reality of the world. As a new lord, he gets the opportunity to leave his castle for the first time of his life to explore the free city of Leoure. But as Yote just starts to get a glimpse of what kindness and freedom look like, he is killed by street robbers. The young man is saved by a mysterious woman who happens to be a talented inventor. She transfers his mind into a cyborg body, allowing him to survive... for a year or two. Yote is now a robot hardly able to move around by himself. But whatever, for him it's the first day of a new life! But to have a life, he needs to become human again. Only the legendary mermaids are said to have the magical powers to achieve such miracles. To help him on his hazardous journey, he hires Doga, a strong and witty street orphan ready to do anything to get out of Leoure and see the world. For both of them, this is the beginning of a road-trip full of surprises!

Takeda launched the series on Futabasha 's Web Action manga website in October 2023. Futabasha shipped the sixth compiled book volume on July 24.

Alien Books will publish Takeda's Badducks manga in English this fall.

Kadokawa published Takeda's One More Step, Come Stand by My Side collection of manga one-shots in April 2022. Yen Press licensed the book and released it in November 2023.
